registered: 2026-09-26, before any smoke-s700/smoke-s701 data (dev-s703 plumbing checks only)
question: Does the package F own-camera executor run three robots in parallel in one sync-SIM world, each on its own camera and own command history only, and does each executor report its deliver job honestly (events, own-camera confirmation) against evaluation-only GT? This tests the executor, not the dialogue.
input_contract: per robot: own robot_cam JPEG + own issued commands + static tagged map v2 + fixed calibrations + order sheet (kind, count, destination zone, coarse pickup slot P{c}-{r} from the scenario config); no pose stub; no peer state; GT only in eval_only/

student.controller: harness/m1_owncam_delivery.py (PR #201, merged read-only up to cceb7ee)

scripted_study_layer.chosen_by: experimenter (Kiro), fixed here before any smoke data; not an LLM
scripted_study_layer.assignment_rule: robots sorted by spawn y north->south; cyan boxes sorted by setup y north->south (ties by x); zip. Destinations north->south: A2, C2, B2. The first robot delivers at once; the second holds 120 SIM s, the third 240 SIM s, then deliver.
scripted_study_layer.order_sheet: one line per cyan box: kind cyan, count 1, required_robots 1, destination zone, initial_location {pickup_bay, slot} = coarse slot of the setup placement (package A rule: regions.pickup split 2 columns x 3 rows)

seed_rule: smoke seeds = the first two seeds >= 700 whose three cyan boxes stand in three different coarse pickup slots (700, 701); 703 is the next such seed and is used for plumbing only

gates.E1: both smoke episodes produce result.json without a host exception (an infrastructure failure = run dir without result.json)
gates.E2: every accepted job of every robot has exactly one job_started and exactly one terminal event (job_done or job_failed); every robot receives its deliver job
gates.E3: isolation audit: every frame fed to executor k has robot_id k and camera robot_cam (foreign_frames_fed = 0 for all 6 robot-episodes); executor cameras_seen = [robot_cam]
gates.E4: M1 inputs: pose_sources_seen of every robot are own-camera (owncam_pf_v2:<sha8>) only; counts_as_m1 true for every robot whose deliver job reached the own-RGB search
gates.E5: weld OFF: max eq_active 0; cargo_noslip_v1 noslip_iterations > 0 recorded
gates.E6: no false confirmation: no job_done(own_camera_confirmed) for a deliver job whose ordered zone slot holds no cyan box in eval-only GT

reported_not_gated: per-robot m1-style success (scripts/run_m1_owncam.py checks: own-camera sources, pickup from own RGB, skill IN_SLOT claim, GT box in slot, no wall contact, weld off, no face-normal map fallback, within limit, look-back gate on the placement frame, no exception, both-finger contact >= 95% of carry steps, box z >= 0.04 m in carry)
peer-robot contact steps and wall contact steps per robot
evaluation-only localisation error p50/p90 per robot
pass_rule: the executor smoke passes when E1-E6 all hold. Delivery success is reported as observed and is NOT a smoke gate (M1 single-robot success is a separate cohort, PR #201); no success rate is claimed from 6 robot-episodes
stop_rule: run each smoke episode once, both in parallel (2 concurrent sim processes), from one committed source SHA recorded in each manifest; no code change between or during them. An infrastructure failure (no result.json) may be re-run once from the same SHA and is reported. A robot-level failure is a result, never re-run. If E1-E6 fail, report and stop; a fix gets a new episode id and a new pre-registration entry.
conditions: sync SIM (timestep 0.00025 s), OMP/OPENBLAS/VECLIB/MKL threads 1, at most 2 concurrent own sim processes, load average logged at launch and in each manifest; weld OFF; contact profile cargo_noslip_v1 (label: pending user approval per the package brief; PR #201 3a03130 records user approval 2026-09-26)
